text: Mainly latency and the fact that the desktop is behind a home router, so the phone can't connect to it directly. Both sides connect out to a small relay server I wrote, first over plain HTTP to authenticate, then they upgrade to a WebSocket. Polling would have meant a delay on every command and a lot of useless requests when nothing is happening. With a socket the server just pushes the command the moment it arrives.
Good reasoning on the NAT problem and the push model. On the desktop agent, when a command comes in and fails, how do you handle that — does the phone get feedback that it failed?
